features: Product Overview: MPIL Livam DS Tablets are an Ayurvedic health support supplement designed to assist with daily body wellness routines and general health maintenance.
Main Herbs: The main ingredients include Kutki, Makoy, Bhumi Amla, Vidang, Rohitak, Kalmegh, Bhringraj, Punarnava, Parpat, Sharpunkha, Jhabuk, Kasini, Babool Gond, Mandoor Bhasma, and Triphala.
Quantity & How to Use: Provided in a 10x10 tablets pack container; use as directed by the physician or packaging instructions.
General Benefits: Formulated to support general daily vitality, routine physical wellness, and lifestyle balance.
Important Note: Consult your doctor or physician before use.
